title: My anti-hallucination filter was deleting the real gaps
summary: It only kept what it could find in the job description. That was right, and it was also throwing away the answers worth reading.

title: The check-then-act race that was charging users twice
summary: It passed every test I wrote, because every test I wrote ran one request at a time.

title: My cache key was wrong, so I billed people for work I had already done
summary: Same job, same resume, second charge. The key was hashing the rendering along with the inputs.

title: What do you rate-limit on? The bug hiding inside "per user"
summary: It said per user. It was keyed on the token, and the client could mint a fresh token whenever it liked.
